SUPREME COURT BAR ASSOCIATION OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) RULES, 2000
SUPREME COURT BAR
ASSOCIATION OF PAKISTAN
(AMENDMENT) RULES,
2000
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 4th August, 2000]
S.R.O.536(I)/2000, dated
29-7-2000.--In exercise of the powers conferred by section 55 of the Legal
Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973 (XXXV of 1973), and all other enabling
provisions in this behalf; the Pakistan Bar Council hereby makes the following
amendments in the Supreme Court Bar Association of Pakistan Rules, 1989:--
1. Name and commencement.--(a)
These Rules may be called the Supreme Court Bar Association of Pakistan
(Amendment) Rules, 2000.
(b) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Rule 4.--The
existing Rule 4 may be substituted by the following new Rule:
"4. (a)
Every Advocate shall become member of the Association by applying in the
prescribed form and payment of entrance fee with one month's subscription as
prescribed in rule 6(a)(ii).
(b) An Advocate shall apply for membership in the
prescribed form duly proposed by a member and seconded by another, accompanied
by a deposit of entrance fee with at least one month's subscription as
prescribed in rule 6(a)(ii)."
